journal_lines: Copper. Then iron. Then something that wasn't either. Brought back what could be carried.
The vein changed color three times. Followed it as far as it went.
Mixed seam. Copper into iron into something older. Took all of it.
A seam that should not have been one seam. Followed it anyway.
Found a vein that ran like a river through three kinds of stone. Took from each.
The vein bent where the rock bent. Bent further than the rock did, in places.
Worked it until the light failed. Came back the next day. The vein had moved. Slightly.
Pulled enough out of one wall to carry. Left more than I took. The wall did not need everything.
